Life Science · Year 1

Explore living and non-living things, discover the needs of humans, animals and plants, investigate the five senses, and learn about animal and plant parts through fun, hands-on activities.

🌱 3.0 Living & Non-living Things👀 4.0 Human Senses🐾 5.0 Animals🌼 6.0 Plants

🌟 Start Your Science Adventure

Big Idea (Understanding)

Living things have characteristics and basic needs. Humans use their senses to investigate the world, while animals and plants have body parts that can be observed, compared and explained.

🧠 KNOW & DO

📘 KNOW — Facts & Understanding

Characteristics and basic needs of living things; the five human senses and sensory tools; animal body parts and their importance; and similarities and differences among plant parts.

🧪 DO — Learning in Action

Observe, compare, classify, sequence, investigate, draw and label, explain findings, discuss reasons and communicate through sketches, ICT, writing or speaking.
